items.title: fix(acp-adapter): validate --server at startup (#6939)
items.body: Fixes #6939. `bin/opencode-acp-adapter.mjs` took its one operator flag, `--server`, with no validation: a trailing `--server` was silently dropped (adapter talked to the default serve), `--server=` / a flag-like / a non-URL value looped forever on per-request "Failed to parse URL", and a typo'd flag (`--sever`) was silently ignored. ## Change Strict argv at startup in `parseServerUrl` (umbrella #3352), evaluated before the event stream starts and before any ACP traffic: - `--server` with a missing (trailing), empty (`--server=` or `--server ""`), or flag-like (`--…`) value → usage error on stderr naming the flag and the offending value, exit 2. - A value that is not a parseable `http:`/`https:` URL → same fast failure; the resolved `OPENCODE_ACP_SERVER` env value is validated the same way (named as the source). - Any unknown argument (e.g. the `--sever` typo) → usage error naming it, exit 2 — it can no longer silently change which server is dialled. - Valid forms unchanged: `--server `, `--server=`, trailing slashes stripped, env fallback, built-in default (verified live: control still starts against the named server). ## Tests `node --test bin/opencode-acp-adapter.test.mjs` — 18 pass / 0 fail, including 8 new #6939 regression tests: trailing `--server`, `--server=`, `--server ""`, flag-like value, non-URL value, non-http(s) value, typo'd flag, and a bad env value — each asserting the fast non-zero exit naming `--server` (or the env var). The existing well-formed `--server` control suite keeps passing. Queue task 11326 (lane code-m, direct execution lane). --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
